[LIMP.4.2.3] An importer that uses both forms — `import ha`
followed by `from ha import AlarmTriggered` — has both
`ha.AlarmTriggered` and `AlarmTriggered` in scope; both
resolve to the same declaration.
This is permitted (no double-import error) so authors can
use the qualified form for some names and the bare form
for others from the same library.
